notes.title: Forester Simulator: More than just a typical job simulator
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We’re excited to share some updates! After a series of internal changes at the studio, we’re ready to unveil some new developments for Forester Simulator. But first, we know some of you might be curious about the recent changes with 9 lives and what’s going on behind the scenes. Instead of explaining everything here, we’ve got it all laid out in this graphic we posted on social media:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/25fb5c65d81c378e11f403baf1bb0826c27df208.jpg[/img]

Now that we’ve cleared things up, let’s dive into the main event of today’s devlog—exciting new updates for Forester Simulator!

At 9 lives, we aim to go beyond the conventional boundaries of game development. Every title we develop is designed to address the needs and desires that other developers tend to overlook. But there’s more to what makes our games stand out.

We don’t just aim to compete - we strive to raise the bar. Within the same genre and price range, we make it a point to deliver more value to players, offering rich, immersive experiences that set us apart.

Take Forester Simulator's vehicle system, for example. In most job simulation games, driving mechanics are often simplified, and vehicle damage is predictable and basic. But in Forester Simulator, the driving experience is dynamic and interconnected. Your off-road vehicle will rock and sway, and you’ll witness the suspension working in real-time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/d8d263badf356ee8757a8b2d067a101d4b9edb2c.gif[/img]
[i]Drive carefully, unless you're ready to pay for the repairs.[/i]

And that's not all - our game features an advanced vehicle destruction system! Minor damages, like a loose bumper or hood, are just the beginning. Push your vehicle too hard, and you’ll risk breaking doors or losing your headlights, which could make navigating the forest at night a real challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/63bda226f6949799276d6824a2448c6af9215815.gif[/img]
[i]Crash testing is one of the most exciting parts of the testing process.[/i]

But don’t worry - your forester won’t be stranded. You'll be able to repair even a totaled vehicle, though repairs will require resources. And if you can’t afford to fix it, you might find yourself trekking through the wilderness to the nearest fast travel point - assuming, of course, you've built one! Stay tuned, because there's much more to uncover about the world and mechanics of Forester Simulator.

If you want to be even closer to the development process - you are more than welcome to [url=https://discord.com/invite/cxAj8zDe7a]join our Discord server[/url] and ask us any questions! You can also follow us on [url=https://x.com/9livesvr]X[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/9livesvr]Facebook[/url].

Remember to wishlist Forester Simulator! Thanks!
9 lives team

Be sure to check out Into The Darkness VR, which you'll have the chance to playtest as well.

notes.title: Can you raze down an entire forest in Forester Simulator?
notes.content:
Hey!

We're excited to share some insights into one of the core activities in Forester Simulator: logging. This task is not only crucial for maintaining the health of your forest, but also comes with a variety of approaches to suit your style. Whether you're methodical or adventurous, we've got you covered.

In Forester Simulator, harvesting trees is a responsibility. You'll find designated zones for planting and logging trees. By working within these zones, you'll boost your Forest Health rating. But for those who prefer a more reckless approach, the entire forest is at your disposal. Remember though, if you let Forest Health drop too low, you risk losing your job.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/c6ea544e8f7e83ad1d7733ffaf077476f166d2e5.gif[/img]

Getting started with logging is pretty straightforward. First, check whether the tree is suitable for harvesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/f779d8e130131e9b051fff6b88ec8a79236ef7b6.gif[/img]

From there, the choice is yours:

[list]
[*] Use a Harvester: For those who prefer heavy machinery, the Harvester is at your service.
[*] Go Old School: Feel like getting hands-on? Grab an axe and show off your strength.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/2bb7d53e879e6694a5e98cb6ac0541aeb624244d.gif[/img]

We understand that controlling large, unfamiliar machines can be daunting. That’s why we've worked hard to ensure that operating the Harvester is intuitive, whether you're using a keyboard and mouse or a gamepad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/8fcaa948ed96e5da6f595a3f466d0ca38f25a3e3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38961792/1224212921d9fe948b269dfecd9bceac78ebdee8.gif[/img]

We're nearing an exciting phase in development, where we'll be inviting you to join our playtests. Your feedback is invaluable, and we’re eager to incorporate your suggestions to refine Forester Simulator. Stay tuned for more details on how to participate!

[h3]Wishlist Forester Simulator now to stay up-to-date with all incomings devlogs![/h3]

[i]Embark on an immersive adventure as a forester in charge of the breathtaking open world of Beaverly Hills. Spend cozy time in nature while exploring diverse ecosystems in the freeplay mode or engage in a story driven campaign. Experience a forest filled with lush wildlife, surprising characters and important work to be done, all from the comfort of your home![/i]

[h3]Here are the answers to some questions you may have.[/h3]

[b]Q: Who is the developer of the game, who publishes it?[/b]
A: Forester Simulator is developed by Gameboom VR. Gameboom VR and PlayWay are publishers.

[b]Q: When will the game be released?[/b]
A: No specific release date for now.

[b]Q: Will the game have multiplayer/coop?
[/b]A: Forester Simulator is a singleplayer game

[b]Q: What game modes will be available in the game?[/b]
A: Singleplayer story driven campaign and freeplay mode.

[b]Q: What will the price of the game be?[/b]
A: Not determined yet.

[b]Q: Are there any plans for console release?[/b]
A: It's too early to talk about it. However, the game will be optimized for Steam Deck.

[b]Q: Will the game offer a VR mode?[/b]
A: There is no decision on support for VR at this time.

[b]Q: Why Early Access?[/b]
A: The game will be fully playable and beatable in Early Access. However we would like to get your feedback and improve the game before fully releasing it.

[b]Q: Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]
A: Up to one year.

[b]Q: What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]
A: The game is still work-in-progress and will only get better with time. All features from the Steam page description are already implemented.
